classification: Advisory boundary declaration + trail-signer role separation in .well-known/oracle-keys.json; ApiResponseBuilder success() injects insightDoesNotEnforce meta field on every response
receiptImpact: No receipt fields or signing-key trust windows change. This promotion adds an advisory_boundary section to .well-known/oracle-keys.json (insightDoesNotEnforce=true + signer role descriptions), renames the trail key role from 'sample' to 'trail-signer' and key_id from 'insight-pulse-trail-sample' to 'insight-pulse-trail-signer', and injects insightDoesNotEnforce=true into ApiResponseBuilder.success() meta for every HTTP response. EIP-712 receipt layouts, partner policies, and production attester trust remain identical.
activationRule: This promotion records three boundary-clarity changes: (1) a new trail-signer role in the key registry that verifiers can distinguish from both production attester and synthetic sample roles; (2) a published advisory_boundary section in .well-known/oracle-keys.json so any verifier sees Insight does not enforce verdicts; (3) an ApiResponseBuilder.meta.insightDoesNotEnforce field on every HTTP response. No partner activation, execution authority, or production receipt admission is affected.

compatibilityMatrix.evidence: No partner policy, activation, key, trust pin, receipt layout or verification rule changes. The advisory_boundary declaration is informational only.
